propositions: Commit 465d split the DC transport module and moved all search_issues call sites from transport.py into _base.py and _issues.py, but the structural guard scanning hardcoded _TRANSPORT_SRC path was never updated, causing it to scan an empty file

The guard test_no_search_issues_call_relies_on_the_default_page_size now passes unconditionally because an AST walk of transport.py finds zero search_issues calls, rendering it vacuous and unable to detect new unpaginated callers

The guard must be widened to scan every *.py file in adapters/jira_datacenter/ and include a non-vacuity assertion verifying it observes at least one call site, preventing silent re-rot on future module moves
Four additional single-file AST structural guards across the codebase were similarly vacuated by 465d's split (apply, llm timeout, fetch probe, usage log scanners).
